sector: An independent fourteen room brew house and coffee group across New England, with two flagship kitchens and four counter service coffee rooms.
founded_place_size: Founded 2013, first room in Portsmouth, New Hampshire. Fourteen rooms across New England, two flagship kitchens, four counter service rooms, one shared coffee program.
about: Emberwell runs fourteen rooms under one name and one coffee program, each in a secondary New England town where it is the good room rather than the cheap one. Same room, same welcome, but every store pays its own rent, so the estate is one brand at fourteen prices.
audience: Morning trade aged 30 to 55 that comes in early and lingers for two hours. Guests who read a menu the way they read a good book and treat loud pricing as a sign they are in the wrong kind of room.
price_positioning: Upper middle independent. Plates 14 to 26 dollars, drinks 4.50 to 7. Not a chain and never wanting to read like one: type led, generous, prices set quietly at the end of a line. No combos, no starbursts, no value language.

palette.name: Ember
palette.role: mandatory in the mark's kettle; optional accent elsewhere
palette.usage: The kettle in the house mark, as on emberwell_insert_spring_prior.pdf and emberwell_counter_card_prior.pdf; elsewhere thin rules and leader dots, section heads and the on-now line. Never a price, the name heading a menu line, a ground or a panel.

palette.name: Roast
palette.usage: The brand name heading each piece, the dish or drink name heading each menu line, and the ring lettering of the mark, as on emberwell_insert_spring_prior.pdf and emberwell_counter_card_prior.pdf. Never a ground or panel.

palette.name: Kettle Brass
palette.role: mandatory in the mark's ring; used nowhere else
palette.usage: The ring of the house mark only, as on emberwell_insert_spring_prior.pdf and emberwell_counter_card_prior.pdf. Never type, a rule, a price, a ground or a panel.

palette.name: Steam
palette.usage: Where used, one solid panel behind the drinks list, as on emberwell_insert_spring_prior.pdf and emberwell_counter_card_prior.pdf. Never type, a rule or the page ground.

palette.name: Warm Cream
palette.usage: The page ground of every insert and card, edge to edge, as on emberwell_insert_spring_prior.pdf and emberwell_counter_card_prior.pdf.

palette.name: Slate Ink
palette.usage: The allergen statement and the street address and hours, as on emberwell_insert_spring_prior.pdf and emberwell_counter_card_prior.pdf; also the tagline and descriptions. Never a ground or panel.

typography: Emberwell Brew House sets Kanit against Freight Text Pro. Step 01, the counter card headline, is Kanit SemiBold at 34 pt on 38 pt with 0.01 em negative tracking, and 28 px on 34 px on screen. Step 02, the section head, is Kanit SemiBold at 24 pt on 27 pt, tracking 0. Step 03, the description and price, is Freight Text Pro Book at 9.5 pt on 13 pt, tracking 0, a maximum of 65 characters a line, tabular figures on, with dish names above it at 13 pt in the same face and italic reserved for seasonal lines. Step 04, the town line, is Kanit ExtraLight capitals at 10 pt on 14 pt tracked 0.50 em across the full measure at the foot of every piece. A price is never coloured and never emboldened; it simply ends the line.
voice: Warm and plainspoken, a room talking rather than a brand selling. Short lines, no adjectives stacked for effect. Example: The stout is on until the barrel is done, then it is not.
brand_assets_status: Our old logo file is gone. The cleanest surviving version of the mark is the enamel pin on the apron, of which we hold a close photograph. Approved dish names, descriptions, the drinks list, seasonal line names and the fixed allergen statement all survive as plain text, alongside the public store roster.
values: One consistent welcome across the estate, and honest local pricing that a guest never has to question from one town to the next.

type_system.signature_move: Every piece is signed at the foot with the room's town set in Kanit ExtraLight capitals tracked 0.50 em across the full measure, the one widely spaced line on the page and the only thing that changes from room to room. It is step 04, at 10 pt, deliberately the quietest size and the widest tracking in the scale.
rules: Never colour or embolden a price.
Prices are set quietly at the end of the line in Freight Text Pro Book at 9.5 pt with tabular figures.
The town line sits at the foot of every piece in Kanit ExtraLight capitals tracked 0.50 em across the full measure, and is the only line that changes between rooms.
Kanit SemiBold sets section heads and the counter card headline.
Freight Text Pro Book sets dish names at 13 pt and descriptions and prices at 9.5 pt on 13 pt.
Italic is used only for seasonal lines.
No combos, no starbursts, no value language: never read like a chain.
One consistent welcome across the estate, with honest local pricing a guest never has to question from one town to the next.

palette_rules.distribution: Warm Cream is the page ground of every piece, as on both of last season's press files. Steam, where used, is the only panel colour: one solid panel behind the drinks list. Roast and Slate Ink carry the running text: the brand name heading each piece and the dish or drink name heading each menu line in Roast; the allergen statement, address and hours in Slate Ink; descriptions, the tagline and the town line in Roast or Slate Ink. Every price takes the colour of its own line, Roast or Slate Ink. The mark is reproduced flat, as on both press files: Ember kettle, Roast ring lettering, Kettle Brass ring. Ember is otherwise for thin rules, leader dots, section heads and the on-now line; Kettle Brass is only the mark's ring. Ember and Kettle Brass together cover no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity, the Steam panel and the mark included. No tint, transparency, gradient, shadow or blend mode is applied to any palette colour, and no scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph.
palette_rules.forbidden: No colour outside the six palette hexes for type, panels, rules, buttons, icons or the mark. No price in Ember, Kettle Brass or any other accent, and no bold price, since a price is never coloured and never emboldened. No starburst, burst or badge shape of any colour.
palette_rules.photography: Each insert's photograph is one of the supplied dish and drink frames; no stock, generated or AI-extended image stands in, since the brief declares no Stock exception. It keeps its own corrected colour and is never tinted, duotoned or recoloured toward the palette; the dishes, drinks and walnut counter are not pushed toward Ember, Roast or Warm Cream.
